purpose: Catalog of Houston source layers that can be converted into AO staging feature collections. Geometry is retained in WGS84; AO local-grid conversion remains separately gated by approved Houston coordinate profile.

sources.title: City/Harris Building Department 3D Footprints
sources.publisher: Harris County / City of Houston
limitations: Downtown-focused extent, not citywide.
Height/address/parcel fields are source attributes, not verified interior geometry or entrance locations.

sources.title: Downtown Tunnel Access Points
sources.publisher: City of Houston
limitations: No automatic building-door mapping; access status is source evidence, not current field verification.

sources.title: Downtown Tunnel Businesses
sources.publisher: City of Houston
limitations: Business records do not establish current operating status unless source fields explicitly do so.

sources.title: Buildings With Tunnel Access
sources.publisher: City of Houston / H-GAC
limitations: Building polygons/parcel identifiers do not explicitly relate each building to a particular tunnel access point.

sources.title: Downtown Tunnel Ingress/Egress Points
sources.publisher: City of Houston
limitations: Building and address attributes were null in inspected sample; do not auto-link to buildings.

sources.title: Downtown Tunnel Paths
sources.publisher: City of Houston
limitations: No vertical datum/level evidence in current manifest; preserve as underground-associated geometry, not a metrically resolved Z surface.
Do not connect to street network without explicit portal evidence.

sources.title: Downtown Tunnel Access/Restriction Areas
sources.publisher: City of Houston
limitations: Source restriction polygons require interpretation; preserve attributes and do not invent access rules.

sources.title: H-GAC 2018 LiDAR Building Footprints
sources.publisher: Houston-Galveston Area Council / Harris County GIS
limitations: 2018 LiDAR-derived approximate footprints; known classification errors and omissions.
Not a verified entrance, floor count, room, ownership, or occupancy source.

sources.title: H-GAC Hydrography Polygons
sources.publisher: Houston-Galveston Area Council
limitations: Regional hydrography inventory; validate coverage and source date for each AO boundary.
Water polygons are geographic features, not verified depth, navigability, flood extent, or seasonal condition.

sources.title: H-GAC Major Rivers
sources.publisher: Houston-Galveston Area Council
limitations: Major river linework; not a complete drainage/channel or water-depth model.
Do not infer crossings, bridges, banks, or traversability from centerlines.

sources.title: City of Houston Bikeways
sources.publisher: City of Houston / COHGIS
limitations: Source map combines existing and proposed bikeways; retain status attributes and do not treat all lines as currently rideable.
No automatic routing approval; geometry does not prove current facility condition or legal use.

sources.title: City of Houston Cadastral Parcels
sources.publisher: City of Houston GIS / HCAD
limitations: Public city cadastral MapServer layer; broad county extent, clip with an AO bbox.
Parcel attributes are tax/cadastral evidence, not ownership or occupancy truth for AO.
The converter's field whitelist excludes owner and mailing-contact fields.
sources.source_access_information: HITS-GIS; City of Houston; Harris County Appraisal District
sources.source_license_info: COHGIS informational-use disclaimer; verify source terms before redistribution.

sources.title: City of Houston City Limits View
sources.publisher: City of Houston Planning & Development
limitations: Public view omits pending annexation polygons; boundary categories and effective dates must remain as source attributes.
Reference boundary only; not a legal survey or Kernel-authoritative jurisdiction rule.
sources.source_access_information: City of Houston GIS public view
sources.source_license_info: No separate licence text exposed by ArcGIS item metadata.

sources.title: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer — H-GAC 8-County 2026
sources.publisher: FEMA / Houston-Galveston Area Council
limitations: Regional FEMA NFHL snapshot for the H-GAC 8-county area; preserve effective dates, zone codes and source metadata.
Flood hazard classification is not a real-time flood forecast or a guarantee of on-the-ground conditions.

sources.title: Houston Fire Districts
sources.publisher: City of Houston / Houston Fire Department / HITS-GIS
limitations: Administrative response-district polygons; do not infer actual emergency response times, station coverage, staffing, or operational dispatch rules.
sources.source_access_information: Houston Fire Department, HITS-GIS; City of Houston Open Data

sources.title: Fire Stations Within City of Houston Boundary
sources.publisher: City of Houston / Houston Fire Department
limitations: Published item is an older 2023 snapshot; verify station locations and operational status before use.
The service title mentions hospitals, but the inspected service exposes a Fire Stations point layer and a city boundary layer only; no hospital layer is registered from this service.

not_registered_yet.reason: The City of Houston Cadastral Parcels MapServer layer is registered. HCAD's official quarterly GIS ZIP (https://download.hcad.org/data/GIS/Parcels.zip) remains a separate source snapshot requiring a dedicated ZIP/shapefile adapter, schema/CRS review, licence capture, and checksum. HCAD GIS download page last updated 2026-10-05.

2024 data is available through H-GAC's tile purchase portal; listed price is $100 per tile for 1-50. Confirm purchase/licence and tile index before acquisition; verify horizontal CRS, vertical datum, units, resolution and deliverables.
Prior working notes refer to City GIS Nodes layer 10 and Links layer 12, but exact service URL and schemas have not been confirmed; do not synthesize a graph from nearby road points.
A City-maintained sidewalk polyline inventory is registered, but it is not a complete sidewalk surface polygon dataset. No verified complete road-surface polygon layer is registered.
No complete source; address points and tunnel portals are candidates only and do not automatically establish building entrances or indoor levels.
